_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fiber_reinforced#2. Seven kappa values executed: 0, 0.1 and 1/3 run to normal termination; 0.34, 0.5, 1.0 and -0.1 are each rejected AFTER the deck reads SUCCESS with 'Invalid value for parameter: Material1.kappa' and 'Model initialization failed'. The inclusive upper bound at exactly 1/3 and the read_success-then-fail shape are both required. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'kappa_range=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
